scope.summary: Implement per-seam sublayer ordering (CG-09, MD Set Sublayer): an integer sublayer on seams ordering self-folding sewing (seam allowances, pleat stacks) within one panel's collision/constraint resolution so folded plies settle deterministically instead of fighting, per Section 13.4 layer ordering.
acceptance_criteria: SeamSpec carries optional sublayer: i8; self-collision response between plies of the same panel respects sublayer order (lower stays under) analogous to inter-panel layer_index (MT-096).

Pleat-stack fixture (3 knife pleats) settles in authored order across 5 seeded runs (determinism envelope) with sublayers set, and visibly interleaves incorrectly without them (negative demonstration).
Sublayer participates in Fold Arrangement (MT-460) initial-state ordering.
scope.risk_if_missed: This is the obscure stability lever MD pros use for pleats and allowances; without it stacked folds z-fight and pleated garments cannot ship.

gui_obligation.not_applicable_reason: Backend/solver scope: behavior is observable via TraceProjection, typed receipts, and the 13.12 capture APIs; GUI exposure rides the existing Tailor panels and is validated there.

target_entries: Tailor UserManual > Cloth simulation and physics
